name: add-camera-pipewire-fix
description: Patched PipeWire GStreamer source: libgstpipewire.so rebuilt from PipeWire 1.0.5 with always-copy on by default, so pipewiresrc hands downstream its own copy of each frame instead of PipeWire's mapping. Without it, stopping a recording in GNOME Snapshot faults inside gst_video_frame_copy - 18 crashes in 20 attempts on this board, 0 with the patch. Installed through dpkg-divert, so a later gstreamer1.0-pipewire upgrade cannot silently restore the stock plugin. Kept separate from add-camera-camx because it patches a stock package and helps any pipewiresrc consumer, not only CamX. Costs one full-frame copy per frame, about 3% of one core at 1920x1440. Drop it once PipeWire 1.5.81 or later (upstream commit bb1bb07f6) reaches the archive.
